window.include: Every Japanese keirin meeting whose official local Day1 date falls within the inclusive window, and every positively captured Day1 race from those meetings.
window.exclude: Meetings whose Day1 falls outside the window. Do not include Day2/Day3 merely because they occur inside the dates.

endpoint_basis.start: The first calendar date after the last planned support/fit-side future Day1 block on 2026-09-15.
endpoint_basis.end: The calendar date immediately before the separately reserved final untouched evaluation begins on 2026-09-27.
endpoint_basis.prior_limited_overlap_knowledge_disclosu: Earlier work had already observed isolated overlap facts for some specific future meetings. Those facts do not determine inclusion: the window includes all Day1 starts across all venues for every date 2026-09-16 through 2026-09-26.

capture_rule: Freeze each whole Day1 card from positive PRE evidence before opening its later outcome data. Keep source/transport failures explicit.
primary_population_rule: All eligible races in the frozen window, including explicit baseline fallback for riders without a valid learned rider-circumference term.
